entities.title: Tests
entities.summary: The node:test suites for the engine, the art, replay and the high-score API, online play and the sign-in.
entities.purpose: Checks the game without a browser: build.mjs --test bundles each *.test.ts into dist-test/, and npm test runs them after the typecheck.
boundaries: What each suite checks is recorded in the verification files of the folders it checks: src/engine, src/ui, src and worker.
online.test.ts is the same file in Rally and Shatterbelt, as src/online.ts is.
